summary: Mount Hood NF L-4 cab lookout of the 1930s, removed or destroyed in 1962; the site is now a hike-in viewpoint at the end of Salmon Mountain Trail 787.

facts.status_note: Cab removed or destroyed in 1962; no source says what, if anything, remains on the ground
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Mount Hood National Forest)

access.note: Reached on foot by Salmon Mountain Trail 787 in the Salmon-Huckleberry Wilderness, per Oregon Hikers

visit.trail_note: Oregon Hikers rates the hike moderate, 10 miles with 1,960 feet of gain

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says removed in 1962, Oregon Hikers says decommissioned in 1962, and firelookout.com says destroyed in 1962. The year agrees; the story reports each wording.
Register gives 3,768 ft, Oregon Hikers gives 4,020 ft for the site, and firelookout.com gives 4960 ft. The record keeps no elevation key; the story reports all three.

Register and Oregon Hikers give coordinates that match our record (45.265306, -121.971128). The firelookout.org list gives a different point (45.17912, -121.98071); the record keeps the register point.

notes_for_editor: Both lookout-side sources give only 'the 1930s', so the 1930 year is the decade start. No staffing record in these sources, so none is recorded. What the site is today rests on one Oregon Hikers page, which is a wiki revision (oldid 116289) with no date. Access is recorded as public because the page describes a trail hike; check the trail status before publishing. Our record's coordinates, elevation (1,148.5 m) and agency match the register; no correction proposed.
